type: IGZ v5 level: nine sections with stable tags; tag 0 (index 0) header and type table; tag 8 (index 1) object records; tag 15 (index 2) string data; tag 25 (index 3) Havok 7.1 physics (hkpPhysicsData, collision); tag 31 (index 4) CMPR/DXT1 textures, 32-aligned; tag 44 (index 5) draw-unit descriptors (see igz.geometry.descriptor-table); tag 51 (index 6) vertex blocks and GX display lists (igz.geometry.block-layout); tag 65 (index 7) Havok animation (hkaSplineCompressedAnimation); tag 0 (index 8) FMOD FSB4 sound banks
structure: Tutorial level.bld: sizes 0x4a980, 0x40c840, 0x337fc, 0x17dc0, 0xa4f8a0, 0x5ca3c, 0xa05040, 0x1399a0, 0x2f2e70. Mining and every other level of the disc carry the same nine tags in the same order.

location.offset: section table at 0x10: {offset, size, alignment, tag} x 9

meaning: What each section is for, so that no pointer is followed into the wrong kind of data. Section 8 is audio to the last byte (214 FSB4 banks covering 100% of it on the tutorial): a render node's +0x20 reference into it is a sound, not geometry. Section 4 opens with repeating CMPR blocks (two RGB565 words then four index bytes; the weed's texture reference lands on a green block) and is textures. Sections 3 and 7 begin with the Havok tag and class names. The geometry the editor needs lives in sections 5 and 6 only, and no edit of a placement touches either.
